lines.text: I lift up my eyes to You,
look to the hand of their master,
as the eyes of a maidservant
look to the hand of her mistress,
so our eyes are on the LORD our God
Have mercy on us, O LORD, have mercy,
for we have endured much contempt.
We have endured much scorn from the arrogant,

pictures.scene: Ary Scheffer, Saints Augustine and Monica - the mother in the white veil with her eyes lifted and her face full of light, her son in the orange and brown mantle seated below her with their hands clasped together, the wide blue sky standing open above them and the sea lying out at the right, a song of ascents, I lift up my eyes to You, the One enthroned in heaven
pictures.name: pd_scheffer_ogen

pictures.scene: Johannes Vermeer, Mistress and Maid - the maidservant leaning in out of the dark with the letter held out in her hand, the mistress in the yellow fur jacket with her fair hair bound up and her hand lifted to her chin, her eyes going to the servant's hand, the whole upper half of the picture dark and still, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maidservant look to the hand of her mistress
pictures.name: pd_vermeer_meesteres

pictures.scene: Michael Ancher, Will He Round the Point - the fishermen pressed shoulder to shoulder on the shore all looking the same way out to sea, the man in the yellow oilskins lifting his arm to point, the pale grey sky filling the top of the picture, so our eyes are on the LORD our God until He shows us mercy, have mercy on us O LORD have mercy, for we have endured much contempt
pictures.name: pd_ancher_uitzien

pictures.scene: Christian Krohg, Struggle for Survival - the poor of the town crowded up against the baker's window in the snow with their bare hands stretched up for the loaves, the children standing out at the side with their empty pails and baskets and their faces turned up, the grey winter street running away empty behind them, we have endured much scorn from the arrogant, much contempt from the proud
pictures.name: pd_krohg_verachting
